home.title: Optimize a CATIA tree
home.subtitle: Reorganize a file structure from exported data — no CATIA required, no file moved.
home.step1: Import: scan a local folder (metadata only) or import a CSV / JSON listing.
home.step2: Tree: review metrics (depth, fan-out, duplicates, naming).
home.step3: Suggestions: generate the plan (heuristics + Mistral), then accept / reject.
home.step4: Export: download the CSV plan and the .bat / .sh script, to run yourself.

import.title: Import
import.subtitle: Scan a folder or import a listing.
import.metadataNotice: Metadata only (name, size, date). File contents are never read, nothing is written.
import.dropLabel: Drop a CSV or JSON file
import.emptyDesc: Scan a folder or import a listing to start.

tree.title: Tree
tree.noImportDesc: Select or create an import in the Import tab.
tree.notFoundDesc: The import may have been deleted. Re-import.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.subtitle: Generate a reorganization plan, then accept or reject.
suggestions.emptyDesc: Run the optimization to generate a plan.

export.title: Export
export.subtitle: Download the plan and the reviewable script.
export.noRunDesc: Run the optimization in the Suggestions tab.
export.dryRunBody: The script is run by you; the application never moves, renames or deletes anything.
export.saveNotice: Writes the generated deliverable to the OneDrive output folder (set in Settings). Only the plan / script is written; no CATIA part is modified.

browse.title: Browse OneDrive (input)
browse.noRootDesc: Set the input root in the Settings tab.

diff.title: Compare
diff.subtitle: Detect parts added / removed / modified between two imports.
diff.needTwoDesc: Create at least two imports in the Import tab to compare.

checks.title: Checks
checks.subtitle: Run configurable checks on the current import.

conversion.title: CATIA 3D → Composer conversion
conversion.subtitle: Conversion plan (dry-run).
conversion.dryRun: Generates a mapping + a reviewable Python (win32com) script driving Composer (DRY_RUN by default). No conversion is run by the app.

replacement.title: Part replacement
replacement.subtitle: Replacement plan from a mapping (dry-run).
replacement.dryRun: The POC produces a plan + a CATIA macro skeleton, never executed.
replacement.dropLabel: Drop a CSV or JSON mapping

colorization.title: Part colorization
colorization.subtitle: Assign an RGB color to parts (dry-run).
colorization.dryRun: Generates an RGB color mapping + a reviewable CATIA macro (SetRealColor). Nothing is applied.
colorization.simulation: Simulation — each part in its assigned color:

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Mistral API key and models in use.
settings.apiKeyStored: A key is already stored (leave blank to keep it).
settings.onedriveNotice: OneDrive is read via its locally synced folder (no cloud connection). The input is used to browse / import; the output receives generated deliverables (CSV plans, scripts).
